resources.string:
BananaType uses the following open-source data and software:
- CC-CEDICT — Chinese-English dictionary data, © CC-CEDICT contributors, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0). The dictionary bundled in this app has been modified (entries cleaned and trimmed) from the original release. See https://cc-cedict.org for the original project and full license text.
- jieba — Chinese word segmentation and frequency data, © 2013 Sun Junyi, licensed under the MIT License. See https://github.com/fxsjy/jieba for the original project and full license text.
- OpenHeInput-Android — base input method framework, used with permission from the original author.
